name: Big Walk
context: Big Walk is a cooperative online walking and exploration game by House House (the makers of Untitled Goose Game). Friends wander a large open world together, get lost, solve environmental puzzles that need cooperation, and communicate with in-game tools (walkie-talkies, shouting, signalling) as well as the voice chat. The fun comes mostly from the conversation: getting separated and lost, misunderstandings about where to go, silly physical comedy, and figuring out puzzles together.

categories.funny: Jokes, banter, getting lost, misunderstandings about directions, silly physics or character antics, dumb mistakes, shared laughter.
categories.reaction: Strong emotional reactions: surprise at a discovery, frustration with a puzzle, getting scared, excited shouting.
categories.epic: Solving a puzzle (especially the 'aha' moment), finding a secret, reaching a hard-to-reach place, great teamwork.
categories.context: Short story beats that help the video flow: arriving in a new area, starting a new puzzle, deciding where to go next. Keep these short (5-15 s).
